company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. On its site it describes its work as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

Its published material covers artificial intelligence as a national security subject. The site notes that AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace, a trend it says has fed forecasts about artificial general intelligence. It states that CNAS launched a Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, describing those projects as seeking to improve a country's AI self-reliance. Other items on the site discuss a model called Kimi K3 that identified itself as Claude, Anthropic's model, and quote a comment about a Hugging Face incident followed by the release of a model that is harder to monitor.

The organization's record lists no products and no MCP servers, and no individual lawsuits. It shows a Washington law exposure count of 111.
